reviews.review_title: Amazing game, through the roof potential
reviews.review_description:
Dude this game has alot of things VR players are looking for.

1. Incredible community
2. Incredible progression
3. Incredible owner

The owner is a solo developer and consistently pumps out updates
He also cares about the community.
10/10 would reccomend to anyone.

The game is amazing and fun, especially if you’re into Airsoft and Mil-Sim but also a great game for casual players, I do wish that there would be more freedom with loadout customisation with there being only 2 rifles and one secondary with the rest you have to unlock, I also think it’d be great to see private lobby’s eventually and more maps, but overall one of the best games I’ve played in VR 

Some things I think that should be added 

An Outdoor Map
Private Lobby’s 
And More customisation ￼

Just played the game. Problems with respawning in quick play. You are able to be killed in the lobby. Bad locomotion, like a bad sprinting mechanic and crouching, etc UI moves with your head when you tap the menu. Gun physics on the large gun are quite awkward. The pistol works great though. Aiming mechanics on the large gun are very bad. You should not spawn where you just died. You should spawn where you start and you shouldn't be able to be killed in that zone. Your gun should be on you at all times and the gun needs a much better hitbox. It has a horrible hitbox at the moment. Otherwise great game. I can tell lots of work went into it. Will be playing again.

Overall Airsoft Allstars is a good game, but I can't get over the horrible spawns/spawn protection. Regardless of the map, enemies always spawn right behind me, and when i try to kill them, they have spawn protection and just clear out my entire team. Also, the spawn protection is too long because I keep getting into fights with people that have spawn protection and it is unfair. Lastly, the hig registration is horrendous, I could shoot someone, despite them being hit, they shoot back seconds later and I die. Other than that, I am having fun in the game.

Good game concept, he had great attention to detail when it came to mechanics and made a game worthy of respect. Though this game feels like a game jam project, but has heart and I really want to like it but there need to be some changes to a few things.

1. let me hold my pistol in my dominant hand gosh darnit!!! I can only double grip with my lefthand for some reason
2. The sprint mechanic feels useless. You don't move significantly faster than basic walking, and your aim goes out the window if you try to run and shoot simultaneously.
3. Smooth turn does doesn't have a speed dial. This makes it useless for fast paced scenarios.
4. Permanent V stock. This makes it much harder for me to enjoy the mechanics of the guns, because the aiming makes me feel like my inputs are limited and useless.
5. Brad don't give up, you are doing amazing work, but please make it possible to actually have comfort settings on.
